design_gotchas.title: Lower 250 mA Switch Limit (215 mA Min) & Higher 750 mOhm RDS(on) vs Pin-Identical TPS61040DBVR
design_gotchas.detail: TPS61041DBVR is pin-for-pin and VREF-identical to TPS61040DBVR (1=SW, 2=GND, 3=FB, 4=EN, 5=VIN; VREF=1.233 V), intentionally reducing peak switch limit from 400 mA to 250 mA (215 mA min) and raising RDS(on) from 600 mOhm to 750 mOhm to permit smaller inductors and lower ripple. Dropping TPS61041 into a TPS61040 design loaded above ~15-20 mA at 18 V will collapse VOUT.

design_gotchas.title: VIN Strictly Capped at 6.0 V (7.0 V Abs Max) vs Pin-Compatible 14 V LM27313/LM2733
design_gotchas.detail: TPS61041DBVR shares the exact SOT-23-5 pinout and ~1.23 V VREF with LM27313XMF/NOPB and LM2733XMF/NOPB, but its VIN ceiling is only 6.0 V (7.0 V abs max). Placing TPS61041DBVR on a 9 V or 12 V rail built for LM27313/LM2733 destroys the IC immediately.

design_gotchas.title: Non-Synchronous Boost Needs External >= 30 V Schottky Diode & Offers No Shutdown Load Disconnect
design_gotchas.detail: An external Schottky rectifier rated >= 30 V (e.g., MBR0530) is mandatory between SW and VOUT and stays conductive during shutdown (VOUT remains near VIN - Vf when EN = GND). EN must not be left floating and must stay <= VIN + 0.3 V.

design_gotchas.title: PFM Pulse-Bursting Requires CFF Tuning and Limits Line Regulation Trade-Off
design_gotchas.detail: TPS61041 runs variable-frequency DCM PFM (up to 1 MHz); omitting the feedforward capacitor CFF (~10-22 pF) across R1 induces double-pulse bursting and higher ripple, while excessive CFF degrades line regulation unless paired with a matching FB-to-GND capacitor (p.13-14).

typical_use_cases: Low-power OLED and small LCD bias supply (12 V to 28 V at <= 15-20 mA) requiring minimal ripple and tiny inductors
Compact series white-LED backlight driver for handheld meters and battery-powered portable displays
Low-Iq (28 uA) light-load 3.3 V/5 V to 12 V/18 V auxiliary bias rail from single-cell Li-Ion or 2x NiMH
engineering_summary: The TPS61041DBVR is a low-Iq (28 uA typ) non-synchronous PFM boost converter in SOT-23-5 (DBV) featuring a 30 V switch limited to 250 mA typ (215 mA min; 750 mOhm typ RDS(on)), boosting 1.8 V to 6.0 V inputs up to 28 V (VREF = 1.233 V, ~84.5% peak efficiency). It is the lower-current, lower-ripple pin-compatible sibling of 400 mA TPS61040DBVR (allowing smaller 10 uH inductors) and shares the SOT-23-5 pinout of LM27313/LM2733, but is strictly capped at <= 6.0 V VIN, 250 mA peak switch current, external Schottky rectification (no load disconnect), and variable PFM frequency. Verify load margin and CFF tuning against the official TI datasheet before production.
